name: Experimental evidence of neutrinos produced in the CNO fusion cycle in the Sun
title: Experimental evidence of neutrinos produced in the CNO fusion cycle in the Sun

claim.quote: Experimental evidence of neutrinos produced in the CNO fusion cycle in the Sun

summary.plain: Borexino reports the direct observation, with high statistical significance, of neutrinos from the Sun's secondary fusion cycle (the CNO cycle), which the collaboration calls the first experimental evidence of this process. The abstract says the process is dominant in the energy production of massive stars.
summary.technical: Direct observation, with high statistical significance, of CNO-cycle solar neutrinos, identified as an excess of a few counts per day per 100 t of target above the backgrounds in the Borexino liquid-scintillator detector at LNGS, which the collaboration calls the first experimental evidence of this process.

why_it_matters.value: The abstract says this result quantifies the relative contribution of CNO fusion in the Sun as of the order of 1%, that the process is dominant in the energy production of massive stars, and that the result paves the way to a direct measurement of the solar metallicity by CNO neutrinos.
why_it_matters.quote: This is the first experimental evidence of this process obtained with the unprecedentedly radio-pure large-volume liquid-scintillator Borexino detector

key_value_text.value: Excess of a few counts per day per 100 t of target attributed to CNO-neutrino interactions
key_value_text.quote: the excess of the few counts per day per 100 tonnes of target due to CNO neutrino interactions above the backgrounds

significance.value: stated only as 'high statistical significance'; the abstract gives no σ value
significance.quote: the direct observation, with a high statistical significance, of neutrinos produced in the CNO cycle in the Sun
significance.note: The abstract states 'high statistical significance' but gives no numeric sigma value; a numeric significance would need a further source.
